featuredSeason.title: OG REDDIT TRADING TERMS
featuredSeason.quote: THE INTERNET TAUGHT THE MARKET HOW TO SPEAK.
featuredSeason.summary: Loop travels through the language and legends that shaped Reddit trading culture — one short episode at a time.
featuredSeason.coverIntro: Before the trenches had a name, the internet was already inventing its language. Start with Stonks, then meet the Apes.
featuredSeason.shareText: Loop Gaiden Season 01 — OG Reddit Trading Terms is live.

scenes.title: STONKS.
scenes.body: Loop discovers an ancient law of retail trading: Number goes up. Confidence goes up faster. No DD. Just a green chart, too much caffeine, and one word that explained everything: STONKS. One winning trade — and suddenly you're a genius. 😂
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop investigates Stonks, luck and overconfidence in early retail trading culture

scenes.title: APES TOGETHER STRONG.
scenes.body: Loop discovers the Ape: no fancy terminal, no hedge fund, and one remarkable ability — refusing to sell. Then he finds another. And another. Different people. Same stock. Same red chart. Apes together strong. 🦍∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers how retail traders became stronger together by refusing to sell

scenes.title: ALTSEASON.
scenes.body: Loop discovers Altseason. Bitcoin barely moves while everything else loses its mind. Frogs pump. Dogs pump. Even bananas pump. Nobody asks why. Bitcoin is resting. The alts are partying. 🚀∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers Altseason while Bitcoin rests and the alts rally

scenes.title: BUTTCOIN.
scenes.body: Loop meets the skeptics. Bitcoin believers saw the future of money. They watched every pump with suspicion. Markets moved. Their verdict didn't. To them, Bitcoin had another name: Buttcoin.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers the Bitcoin skeptics and their name for it, Buttcoin

scenes.title: GAIN PORN.
scenes.body: Loop discovers another ritual from the old trenches. Making money wasn't enough. You had to screenshot it, post it, and let everyone stare at the green numbers. +$86,420 in profit. The drinks? Someone else's problem. Welcome to gain porn. 😂
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers the old trading ritual of posting spectacular profits as gain porn

scenes.title: BOGDANOFF: HE BOUGHT? DUMP IT.
scenes.body: Loop finds the meme behind a familiar pain: you wait, you watch, you buy, and the chart immediately collapses. The internet had an explanation. The Bogdanoffs saw you buy. Dump it.
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers the Bogdanoff dump it meme and the feeling of buying before a market dump

scenes.title: FUD: FEAR, UNCERTAINTY & DOUBT.
scenes.body: Everything looked perfect. Then one rumor became five. Fear. Uncertainty. Doubt. Sometimes the chart moved first. Sometimes your mind did. ∞
scenes.ariaLabel: Loop discovers FUD, fear uncertainty and doubt, as rumors shake retail trading conviction
